conflicts.topic: Late birth registration fee after 10 years
conflicts.claim_a: LGD-referenced schedule via MOFA mission: BDT 50 after 5 years (no separate 10-year tier).
conflicts.claim_b: LegalClarity guide: BDT 500 after more than 10 years.
conflicts.resolution: UNRESOLVED — prefer Tier-2 LGD-referenced schedule; do not publish BDT 500 as official.
conflicts.likely_reason: Outdated/incorrect secondary guide or different historical schedule.

conflicts.claim_b: Some secondary sites state BDT 100 for other corrections too
conflicts.resolution: Prefer MOFA English notice distinguishing DOB 100 vs other 50; mark secondary ambiguity.
conflicts.notes: bdservicerules table itself shows 50 for other; another blog claimed 100 — unresolved blog noise.
